# Phase 2 summary (generated by `experiments/phase2.py`)

Summary written at commit `2fb13f05e59d1fa68ef26af04cbe7fb3a2f36819` (dirty: True), 2026-11-05T04:22:10+00:00; each run's own commit is in its record. Training: 2 run(s) at commit(s) `51db155`, `6419e22`; the per-run wall times sum to 144 min (~21 min with 7 workers); this invocation took 0.2 min.

All NLLs in nats per symbol on 512 test sequences of length 32. *Gap* = model test NLL - the source's own NLL on the same sequences (paired; its expectation is the per-symbol KL). A run **fails** if it crashed, diverged or its gap is >= 0.01. Mean ± SE and the bootstrap CI are over all runs, failures included.
